## Problem (parity siblings of the tickets-branch invariant violation)
Two more tickets-branch writers bypass the shared store seams and the two-part invariant
(under the unified write lock + auto-commit/publish), same class as projects_store
(ticket fea4-f98c-f1a2-4168, landed):
1. reconcile_helpers._commit_binding_store_snapshot (reconcile_helpers.py:169) commits
   .bridge_state binding/rotation/link state via raw git_adapter.add + commit. git_adapter
   imports only rebar._store.gitutil.run_git — it does NOT acquire rebar._store.lock.write_lock,
   so it races the ticket-CLI _push_tickets_branch() and concurrent GHA commit-back (the
   exact race the write lock exists to prevent).
2. alert_store._atomic_write (alert_store.py:84) hand-rolls tempfile+os.replace instead of
   the shared rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write seam.

## Use the EXISTING seams (NO new facade, NO redesign) — same as ticket fea4
- rebar._store.push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch(tracker, *, message=...) — commits all
  pending tracker changes under the unified write lock (+ rebase guard) then pushes.
- rebar._store.fsutil.atomic_write — the shared crash-atomic write.

## Approach
1. _commit_binding_store_snapshot: replace the lock-bypassing raw git_adapter add/commit
   with a call to push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch(tracker_dir, message=..., strict=True)
   INSIDE the existing try/except. strict=True maps a PushDeliveryError back onto the current
   fail-open posture (except -> return False + append the binding-commit-failure alert); a
   clean tree is a no-op commit (no-op-when-clean idempotency preserved); on success return
   True. The seam stages via `git add -A` under the lock (mirroring GHA commit-back) rather
   than today's selective 5-file staging: in a normal pass only the binding-state files are
   dirty in .tickets-tracker at that point (projects.json is a rare operator write;
   prev_snapshot.json is written AFTER this call), so the committed set matches, and unifying
   onto the locked commit+push is the intended parity fix. No new helper is added.
2. alert_store._atomic_write -> fsutil.atomic_write. RESIDENCY DETERMINED = LOCAL SCRATCH:
   alert_store writes to repo_root/bridge_state/bridge_alerts (no dot), which .gitignore
   ('bridge_state/') ignores; the tickets branch carries only the dotted .bridge_state/*
   (git ls-tree origin/tickets shows bindings/get_rotation/last-pass/peer_confirmations/
   prev_snapshot/projects.json, NO bridge_alerts). So fsutil.atomic_write ALONE is correct —
   NO publish/commit path. Preserve exact serialized bytes, mode 0o600 (mkstemp default, no
   chmod today), and fsync durability via
   fsutil.atomic_write(path, content, permissions=0o600, fsync=True).

## Constraints — BEHAVIOR-PRESERVING
Verify NO functional change beyond lock+seam adoption: same fail-open on commit error, same
no-op when nothing changed, same serialized bytes for alert files. Reuse existing seams ONLY.

## Testing / Verification
- RED-first: add a test asserting _commit_binding_store_snapshot INVOKES
  push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch (patch the seam, not subprocess) and that a raised
  PushDeliveryError yields fail-open (returns False, pass not aborted, alert appended); and a
  byte-identity test for the alert_store fsutil.atomic_write swap. Watch it fail RED, then
  convert to GREEN. Re-point existing subprocess-mocking tests in
  tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/state/ at the seam.
- Proving commands (all must pass): `make lint`; `make typecheck`;
  `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/ -q`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] _commit_binding_store_snapshot serializes through the unified write lock via
      push.commit_and_push_tickets_branch(strict=True); fail-open (False + alert on failure)
      and no-op-when-clean idempotency are preserved — pinned by a test patching the seam.
- [ ] alert_store._atomic_write is replaced by fsutil.atomic_write; residency determined =
      local scratch (documented); no publish path added; exact bytes / 0o600 mode / fsync
      preserved — pinned by a byte-identity test.
- [ ] No functional/behavioral change beyond lock+seam adoption.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/ -q`
      all pass (modulo the known-unrelated state/test_ref_lock.py flake).

## Sequencing
Depends on fea4 (landed). Edits reconcile_helpers.py + alert_store.py (+ tests) — disjoint
from A/C/D.
